mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strong household demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS has increased for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it indicates accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve's tightening cycle increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.
